$comment: Phase 2 MCP tool contracts. Sourced from shared/src/types.ts (zod schemas), mcp/src/server.ts (registered descriptions), and mcp/src/tools/*.ts (runtime IO). All nutrient amounts are in the nutrient's KDRI unit; nutrient identifiers are internal nutrient_code strings.

tools.name: calculate_dynamic_ri
tools.description: Compute the weight-adjusted recommended daily intake (RI) for the given target_nutrients from the user's age, gender, and weight. Call this first, once target nutrients are known, to establish personalized dose targets.
tools.when_to_call: First, before recommending any product — to establish personalized target amounts. Requires known age, gender, and weight_kg (blank-filled with cohort averages upstream if the user omitted them).

target_nutrients.description: nutrient_code list to compute RIs for.

custom_ri.description: Map keyed by nutrient_code. A code with no matching KDRI base row is omitted (never dosed at 0).

base.description: KDRI base RI for the selected bracket.

factor_per_kg.description: Per-kg scaling factor; null when the nutrient is not weight-scaled.

value.description: Final personalized RI (weight-scaled when factor_per_kg is present, else base).

unit.description: KDRI unit for this nutrient (e.g. mg, mcg, IU-derived).

tools.name: validate_ul_guardrail
tools.description: Check whether combined current+diet+proposed intake exceeds any nutrient's Tolerable Upper Intake Level (UL) and return the safe approved subset with any violations. Call once a proposed supplement set exists, before finalizing.
tools.when_to_call: Before finalizing recommendations — after a proposed supplement set exists, to guarantee no nutrient's combined intake breaches its UL.

current_supps_intake.description: nutrient_code -> amount in KDRI unit, from the user's existing supplements.

proposed_supps_intake.description: nutrient_code -> amount from the recommendations being validated.

is_safe.description: True when no nutrient total exceeds its UL.

approved_recommendations.description: Proposed items retained after dropping UL-breaching contributors.

tools.name: check_nutrient_interactions
tools.description: Return conflict/synergy info and an AM/PM timing schedule that separates antagonistic pairs for the given nutrient_list. Call after choosing which nutrients to recommend.
tools.when_to_call: After choosing which nutrients to recommend — to split the day's doses into a non-conflicting morning/evening schedule and surface interaction cautions.

nutrient_list.description: nutrient_code list to schedule and check.

conflicts_found.description: True when at least one antagonistic pair required separation.

morning_AM.description: nutrient_codes to take in the morning.

evening_PM.description: nutrient_codes to take in the evening.

cautions.description: Human-readable interaction notes; includes a best-effort caution when an odd-cycle conflict cannot be perfectly 2-colored.

tools.name: normalize_medical_data
tools.description: Standardize raw lab-test values and flag each low/normal/high against reference ranges. Call when the user provides health-checkup numbers that need interpretation.
tools.when_to_call: When the user provides health-checkup lab numbers (OCR'd or typed) that need interpretation before profiling.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find DSLD-catalog supplement products supplying the target_nutrients, with per-serving normalized content, ranked by coverage. Call after target RIs are known to pick concrete products.
tools.when_to_call: After target RIs are known — to pick concrete products that deliver the needed nutrients. Optionally filter by dosage form or exclude ingredients.

target_nutrients.description: nutrient_code list the product should supply.

form.description: Dosage-form substring filter (ILIKE), e.g. capsule, tablet.

products.description: Up to 50 products, ranked by target-nutrient coverage descending.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve cited nutrition/interaction evidence passages semantically similar to a query. Call to ground an explanation or recommendation with a source.
tools.when_to_call: When an explanation or recommendation needs a grounded, citable source. Provide a natural-language query (Korean or English).

query.description: Natural-language search query; embedded with input_type 'query'.

nutrient_code.description: Optional; accepted for forward-compat but NOT used to filter (chunks have null nutrient_code).

k.description: Number of top passages to return.

chunks.description: Top-k passages ordered by ascending cosine distance (most similar first).

tools.name: resolve_nutrient_codes
tools.description: Resolve free-text nutrient/supplement names (Korean or English) to canonical nutrient_code values, reporting the matched synonym and a confidence of exact/synonym/none.
tools.when_to_call: Once up front (Normalizer): turn the user's supplement list and abnormal-lab signals into nutrient_code strings before any other tool runs.

tools.name: fill_missing_profile
tools.description: Fill missing weight (cohort median-weight table) and missing current-intake (cohort RI base) and return an advisory listing exactly what was estimated.
tools.when_to_call: Normalizer, when the user omitted weight or current intake.

tools.name: compute_intake_coverage
tools.description: Compare summed (current+diet+proposed) intake against each nutrient's personalized RI and classify it deficient/adequate/excess with a percentage.
tools.when_to_call: Reviewer, after a UL check, to detect whether dropping a product left any target nutrient deficient. Its result also feeds the Aggregator's intake visualization.
